subject.title: feat(ui): merge voice and video talk into one button with in-call camera toggle

question: Should realtime talk permanently replace the direct video-talk launcher with an audio-first call whose camera can only be enabled from the active-call controls?
rationale: This is a user-visible interaction and permission-timing change, not a mechanical bug fix; the protected maintainer label indicates that product intent should be confirmed before merging.

options.title: Adopt audio-first calls
options.body: Merge the consolidated launcher after final CI and interactive proof confirm that lazy camera enablement is the desired default.

options.title: Preserve a direct video entry
options.body: Keep or redesign a discoverable direct-video path if maintainers consider immediate camera activation an important workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt audio-first calls
recommendation.body: Merge the consolidated launcher after final CI and interactive proof confirm that lazy camera enablement is the desired default.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author supplied the product rationale and implementation; confirmation should come from the person or team owning the Control UI interaction direction.
